messages:
alejandro: Taking the swing shift — quick async runthrough. Current incident: embeddings ingestion spike in eu-west1 (5xxs + tail latency). Mitigations started.

alejandro: Actions taken so far:
```
# scale workers in eu-west1
kubectl scale deploy/embed-workers -n embeddings --replicas=12
# reduced batch size on canary
kubectl set env deploy/embed-workers BATCH_SIZE=8 -n embeddings --record
```

maria: saw the alerts. Do we know root cause? KV cache pressure or upstream IO?

jonathan: Logs show a burst of large requests from a customer ingest job (~30k vectors/min) + high KV eviction rate. snippet: 
```
ERROR [kvcache] eviction_ratio=0.82 keys_evicted=12456
WARN  [ingest] request_size=1.2MB model=embed-large
```

sam: paging infra oncall — @tasha are you able to stay on this shift?

tasha: I'm oncall. Confirmed autoscaler applied, bumped reserved dedicated for embeddings. Also attached a temp routing rule to route non-critical traffic to a lower-cost embed-small variant.

maria: nice. Any downstream fallout (reranker / chat path)?

jonathan: reranker saw a small uptick in latency (p95 from 120ms->210ms) but no errors. We added a circuit to degrade to cached responses for non-interactive routes.

alejandro: Deploy-bot reported the scale succeeded: 
```
deploy-bot: scaled deployment embed-workers to 12 replicas in eu-west1
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout of batch-size=8 succeeded on 3 nodes; no 5xxs for 6 minutes.

tasha: I disabled background compaction for the KV shard that's hot (temp), to reduce IO contention. Will re-enable after traffic normalizes.

sam: Pagerduty note sent to infra-team. PD escalation stayed in low due to active mitigation.

maria: blocker for me: need a quick review on PR #1453 (increase cache TTLs + metrics) so it can be merged if we need a longer-lived mitigation.

jonathan: I'll review now, pinging you in PR comments.

alejandro: Next steps/plans: monitor error rate & p95 for 30m. If stable (<1% errors, p95<180ms) we'll revert routing change and slowly ramp batch back up. If not, escalate to emergency capacity plan (hot-add GPUs).

alejandro: Follow-ups: jonathan to finish PR, tasha to keep infra watch and annotate any further KV shard changes, maria to validate customer ingest throttles, sam to keep PD status updated. I'll compile a short incident note and reopen if things regress. :thumbsup:

tasha: ack — posting brief notes to #incidents after 30m check-in.

jonathan: PR reviewed + minor comment, should be quick.

maria: validating ingest throttles now, will report back in 10.

alejandro: Thanks team — handing over to nightwatch in 45m, will leave runbook steps in thread.

pagerduty-bot: Incident annotated: incident_id=INC-2026-054, severity=major, status=mitigated (monitoring).
